name: Stachys
title: A beloved fellow worker in Christ
summary: Stachys was a Christian in Rome whom Paul mentions in his letter to the Romans. He is described by Paul as 'my beloved', suggesting a close friendship or that Stachys may have been one of Paul's converts. The name Stachys was common among slaves and freedmen in the Roman Empire.

keyEvents.title: Greeting from Paul
keyEvents.description: Paul sends a personal greeting to Stachys in his letter to the church in Rome, calling him 'my beloved', which shows the close bond between them.
